claims.statement: 소련측 한국 민간인 폭격 관련 S/1679 초안은 1950-08-08 안보리에서 즉시 채택되었다
claims.reason: ROK defense minister 8/10 statement responds to Soviet August 8 accusation, but UN official meeting index places vote on S/1679 at 1950-09-07 (S/PV.497), NOT ADOPTED 1-9-1. Proposal/discussion and later vote separate.

reviewHistory.change: UN index moved from support to contradiction for false adoption statement; ROK statement moved to contemporaneous opposing position.

claims.statement: 1950-08-14 라우 인도대표의 위원회안이 안보리 정식 결의로 채택되었다
claims.reason: UN 1950 official meeting index shows S/PV.487 on Aug14 with no recorded resolution outcome. This alone does not rule out procedural motion; verbatim minutes needed.

reviewHistory.change: Absence of recorded resolution outcome in UN index does not by itself disprove procedural motion; reclassified insufficient.

claims.statement: 1950-09-06 소련 S/1668 한국문제 초안은 안보리 결의로 채택되었다
claims.reason: UN S/PV.496 index explicitly records S/1668 NOT ADOPTED (1-8-2); S/1653 vetoed (9-1-1). Distinguish different draft numbers.

reviewHistory.change: UN index moved from support to contradiction for false adoption statement; ROK statement moved to contemporaneous opposing position.
